source.attribution: Źródło: Repozytorium Dokumentów Finansowych — KRS (Ministerstwo Sprawiedliwości).

access.note: Per-company free download (XML+PDF). Mass/automated access via the PRS-eKRS module requires registration. Respect portal terms; throttle.

pagination.note: Enter KRS -> list of filed documents -> download each XML/PDF. Trigger from KRS dzial3 wzmiankiOZlozonychDokumentach. For scale use the PRS-eKRS module (registration).

snapshot.note: Persist the raw e-Sprawozdanie XML; parse against the versioned MF schema.

parsing.notes: Handle multiple MF schema versions + entity-type variants (mikro/małe/inne/banki) + two P&L variants (kalkulacyjny/porównawczy). Read jednostka (whole/thousands) and scale; store waluta (PLN). Some entities PDF-only / XBRL (listed).

mapping_rules.financial_statements: One record per period; map bilans + rachunek zysków i strat.
mapping_rules.matching: Join on krs to the spine; trigger from KRS wzmianki.

fixture_requirements: inne (large) statement: full bilans + rachunek zysków i strat (wariant kalkulacyjny)

live_test_plan.smoke: For a known KRS, list RDF documents; download one e-Sprawozdanie XML; parse suma bilansowa + przychody netto + zysk/strata netto.
live_test_plan.full: For the spine entities with wzmianki, fetch the latest statements; parse per MF schema version; normalize to financial_statements[]; throttle.

blockers: Versioned MF schema + entity-type/P&L variants — parser must handle all.
Units (whole vs thousands) must be scaled.
Mass access via PRS-eKRS needs registration.
